title: jacobaea paludosa subsp. lanata
intro: Jacobaea paludosa subsp. lanata, commonly known as Marsh Cudweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae) found in wetlands, marshes, and meadows. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. It is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties due to its ability to soothe coughs and alleviate congestion. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Cudweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
